an10.116:1.1: atha kho ajito paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an10.116:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ajito paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.116:2.1: amhākaṃ bho gotama paṇḍito nāma sabrahmacārī.
an10.116:2.2: tena pañcamattāni cittaṭṭhānasatāni cintitāni, yehi aññatitthiyā upāraddhā pajānanti upāraddhambhāti.
an10.116:3.3: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo,
an10.116:3.4: yaṃ bhagavā bhāseyya, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an10.116:4.1: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an10.116:4.2: evambhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.116:5.1: idha bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti, abhinippīḷeti. tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
an10.116:5.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti.
an10.116:5.3: paṇḍito vata bho, paṇḍito vata bhoti.
an10.116:6.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti, abhinippīḷeti. tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
an10.116:6.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā
an10.116:7.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ ca vādaṃ adhammikañca vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti, abhinippīḷeti. tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
an10.116:7.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti paṇḍito vata bho, paṇḍito vata bho’ti. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ ca vādaṃ adhammikañca vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti, abhinippīḷeti. tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti. tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti ‘paṇḍito vata bho, paṇḍito vata bho”ti. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti, abhinippīḷeti. tena ca dhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti. tena ca sā dhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:7.3: paṇḍito vata bho, paṇḍito vata bho’ti.
an10.116:8.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.116:8.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthaṃ ca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
an10.116:9.1: katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo, katamo ca dhammo: katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho:
an10.116:9.4: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.116:9.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.116:11.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.116:11.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.116:12.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.116:12.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo, yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.116:12.4: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
